responsibility: Defines the main AVX-512DQ intrinsic interface for doubleword/quadword and mask-register operations beyond AVX-512F. It supplies mask test and logical helpers for 8- and 16-bit mask widths, conversion and load/store utilities for mask registers, plus a large collection of DQ-specific vector operations such as wider inserts, fpclass tests, and reduce/range scalar forms, serving as the full-width DQ companion to avx512vldqintrin.h.
